privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy applies to the mobile and web games published by Littlejoy Games, to shopkivoo.com and to our player support. It explains what information is collected when you play, which advertising and analytics services our games use, and the choices you have. Not every game or edition uses every service described here. The store listing and in-game notices for each edition show what it uses.
sections: Littlejoy Games is a game development team of university students based in Los Angeles, United States. We publish the games and operate this website. For any question or request about your personal information, contact us at the email address on this page.
Game data on your device: progress, levels, items, achievements and settings are saved in app or browser storage so you can continue where you left off. Playing does not require an account.

Information collected automatically: when a game includes advertising or analytics services, those services may collect device and app information (such as device model, operating system, language and app version), identifiers (such as an app-instance ID, the advertising ID where permitted, and the vendor ID on iOS), your IP address and the approximate location derived from it, usage data (such as sessions, screens viewed, levels started or completed, and ad impressions and clicks) and crash or performance data.
Information you give us: if you email us, we receive your email address, your message and any attachments.
Purchases: if a game offers in-app purchases, Apple or Google processes the payment. We receive only a confirmation of what was bought, never your card details.
Our games do not ask for your name, precise location, contacts, photos or microphone. If a future feature needs such data, we will explain why and ask for your permission first.

We use information to run and save your games; show ads, limit how often you see them and grant rewards for watching optional ads; measure ad and marketing performance; understand how players use the games so we can improve levels and fix problems; detect fraud and abuse; answer support requests; and meet legal obligations.

Where the GDPR or a similar law applies, we rely on performance of our contract with you (providing the game), our legitimate interests (analytics, security and non-personalized ads), your consent (personalized advertising and other uses that require consent) and legal obligations.

Many of our games are free and supported by ads. We currently use Google AdMob. We may also show ads from other networks, either directly or through AdMob mediation. These may include TikTok’s advertising services, such as Pangle. The ad networks used in a game may collect the information described above to serve and measure ads, prevent fraud and, where permitted, personalize ads. These networks process this information as independent controllers under their own privacy policies.

When we promote our games on platforms such as TikTok or Google, a game may use the platform’s software development kit (SDK) to send install and in-game events, together with the device advertising ID where permitted. The platform uses this to measure which campaigns lead to installs.

In the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, Switzerland and other regions where consent is required, the game asks for your choice before personalized ads are shown. You can change or withdraw that choice at any time in Privacy Options in the game’s settings, where available. If you do not consent, you may still see non-personalized ads based on context, such as the game you are playing.

Our games use Google Firebase. Firebase Analytics records an app-instance ID, events such as level starts, level completions and in-app purchases, ad impressions and ad revenue, device information and approximate location. Some games use Firebase Crashlytics, which collects crash traces and device state at the time of a crash. Firebase data may be linked with AdMob and with the ad platforms we use for campaigns, so that we can understand which ads and campaigns work. Where permitted, this includes the advertising ID.
We use these reports in aggregate to understand gameplay, balance difficulty and fix bugs. We do not use them to identify you by name. User-level analytics data is kept for no more than 14 months.

We share information only with service providers and partners that help us run our games and website. These include Google (AdMob, Firebase and Gmail); any additional ad networks or measurement partners used in a game, such as TikTok or Pangle; Apple and Google Play for distribution and purchases; and Cloudflare for this website. We may also disclose information when the law requires it, to protect players, us or others, or as part of a merger or acquisition.

We do not sell personal information for money. Under some US state privacy laws, letting ad partners collect identifiers for personalized advertising can count as a “sale” or “sharing” of personal information. To opt out, turn off personalized ads in the game’s Privacy Options, limit ad tracking on your device (see below) or email us.

Cloudflare delivers this website’s pages and images. To return a page, protect the site and diagnose failures, it may process your IP address, the page requested, the time of the request, browser information and the response status. Its global network may process requests outside your country.

This website has no advertising tags, studio analytics, contact forms or checkout, and it does not read your game saves. If you open a link without a language prefix, the server uses your browser’s preferred languages to choose the page language. This does not use a cookie.

We use your email address, message and any attachments to reply, investigate the issue or act on your request. Our support mailbox is hosted by Google (Gmail). Please do not send passwords, identity documents or other personal details we do not need.
We keep emails only as long as needed to resolve the request, handle a related dispute or meet a legal obligation. Then we delete them.

Our website is served over HTTPS, and data sent by our games’ SDKs is encrypted in transit. Only the people handling a request can access support emails. We keep personal information only as long as needed for the purposes in this policy. Partners keep the data they collect under their own retention policies.

Our team and service providers are located in the United States and other countries, so your information may be processed outside your country. Where required, transfers are protected by safeguards such as the European Commission’s Standard Contractual Clauses.

Ads: on iOS, you can allow or deny tracking under Settings → Privacy & Security → Tracking. If you deny tracking, apps cannot access the advertising ID (IDFA). On Android, go to Settings → Privacy → Ads to reset or delete your advertising ID. In the game, open Privacy Options, where available, to change your consent.

Game data: delete the app, or on Android clear its storage, to remove local data. For a browser game, clear the site data. This permanently erases progress. We cannot restore or erase a save that exists only on your device.

Depending on where you live, you may have the right to access, correct, delete, restrict or port your personal information; to object to processing; to withdraw consent; and to opt out of the sale or sharing of your information and of targeted advertising. Using these rights will not lead to any discrimination against you. To make a request, email us and tell us which game it concerns. Data collected by an SDK is linked to identifiers on your device, not to your name. If the game’s settings show a player ID, please include it. Otherwise we will help you use the partner’s own tools. We may ask for the minimum information needed to verify your request, and we will reply within the time required by law. You may also complain to your local data protection authority.

Our games are made for a general audience. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13, or under the minimum age set by the law in your country. If a game is directed at children or is part of a family program such as Google Play Families, we set up its ads and analytics accordingly. This means no personalized ads, no collection of the advertising ID, and only ad networks certified for that program. If you believe a child has given us personal information, contact us and we will delete it.
Platforms and changes to this policy
Apple, Google Play and other distribution platforms handle store accounts, downloads, backups and payments under their own policies. Read any additional notice provided with your edition of a game.

We will update this policy when our practices change, for example when a game adds a new ad network or analytics service. We will also update the date at the top of the page. Where the law requires it, we will ask for your consent again.

terms.intro: These terms apply to games published by Littlejoy Games, our official website, portfolio and player support. Distribution platform terms and any license supplied with an edition also apply.
sections: You may browse our site, explore and download available games, and contact the studio. Obtain games through authorized channels. App Store and Google Play editions are also subject to the applicable store terms and any additional license supplied with that edition.

Subject to the applicable terms, you may play for personal, noncommercial enjoyment on your compatible devices. The games and materials remain the property of their rights holders. Do not redistribute installers without permission, impersonate an official release or interfere with other players or services. Clearing data, deleting an app or changing devices may result in lost progress. Your rights under applicable law remain intact.

The studio and its licensors retain rights in the games, artwork, characters, screenshots, names and website content. You may link to the site and share its public pages. Personal viewing, lawful quotation, review and other uses permitted by law remain available. For commercial reuse, merchandise or republication of an asset collection, request permission by email. Third-party works remain subject to their own licences.

Use the website lawfully. Do not impersonate the studio, distribute altered downloads as official releases, interfere with the site, or send material that infringes another person’s rights. Please send rights concerns privately with the relevant URL and enough detail for us to identify the material.

Projects labeled “Game concept” are design explorations. Their design, release plans and timing may change. See the relevant store listing for availability in your region. The website does not process game transactions.

Access may be interrupted by maintenance or network failures. We aim to correct significant errors reported to us. Nothing in these terms limits mandatory consumer protections, statutory remedies or liability that cannot lawfully be excluded. Minors should involve a parent or guardian when permission is required.

The effective date identifies this version. Material changes will be published on this page. For permission requests, questions or complaints, contact Littlejoy Games using the email below. You retain access to the courts and remedies available under applicable law.
